The '''2012–13 Danish Superliga''' season was the 23rd season of the [[Denmark|Danish]] [[Danish Superliga|Superliga]], which decided the [[Danish football championship]]. It marked the 100 year anniversary of the first ever Danish Football Championship, [[1912–13 Danish National Football Tournament|held in 1912–13]].

The season began on 13 July 2012 and ended on 20 May 2013.

==Teams==
[[Lyngby Boldklub]] and [[HB Køge]] finished the [[2011–12 Danish Superliga|2011–12 season]] in 11th and 12th place, respectively, and were relegated to the [[2012–13 Danish 1st Division|2012–13 1st Division]].

The relegated teams were replaced by [[2011–12 Danish 1st Division|2011–12 1st Division]] champions [[Esbjerg fB]] and runners-up [[Randers FC]].
